description: The Actions window shows access denied, but offers no retry, reconnect, or install guidance and the local dev browser records the 403 as a console error.
expected: A repo dashboard GitHub-provider failure should be contained to the affected window with a clear next action or retry path.
actual: The Actions window only says "Access denied to this repository." and the browser shows a Next dev issues overlay for the 403.
suggested_fix: Expand repo dashboard error states with retry/setup actions and avoid surfacing expected permission denials as dev-overlay errors.

description: The shorthand `/{owner}/{repo}` route starts a repo chat instead of opening the repo dashboard.
expected: For the repository dashboard path, `/repos/{owner}/{repo}` and `/{owner}/{repo}` should either both land on the dashboard or the UI/catalog should make the distinction explicit.
actual: `/dennisonbertram/synthetix` opened a new repo-backed chat session on `main` instead of showing the repo dashboard.
suggested_fix: Decide whether shorthand repo URLs are session launchers or dashboard aliases, then align routing, labels, and docs/catalog expectations.
